title: What If You Could Drive to the Moon at Highway Speed?

scenes.text: What if you could drive to the Moon at highway speed? Pack for half a year.
The Moon is about 238,855 miles away. At sixty miles an hour, that's roughly 166 days of nonstop driving.
You'd reach the space station's altitude, about 250 miles up, in just over four hours.
The Moon's orbit isn't a circle. At its closest, it's around 226,000 miles, which would save you more than a week.
Even then, you'd be driving for months, with no road, no air and no fuel stops.
Half a year behind the wheel to reach the only other world humans have ever visited.
